thread:
Noah (People Ops): Heads-up: we're rolling out an update to the Code of Conduct + harassment policy next week. Short read (5-7 min) + mandatory one-click acknowledgment.
Priya (People Ops): Timeline: release Wed 9am UTC, open acknowledgment window = 14 days. We'll run optional office hours for Q&A during that window.
Sofia (Legal): Note: the updated text includes a reporting flow appendix and a minor change to bystander expectations. Legal requests signed ack for everyone in the region covered by the policy.
Marco (Recruiting Ops): For new hires starting during the window, do they need to sign pre-boarding or post-onboarding? We usually include docs in offer packs.
Noah (People Ops): Good question. We'll add the ack link to the offer pack and flag new hires as "must complete by day 7 of start date." Recruiting should include the link in the offer email.
Marco (Recruiting Ops): Got it. I'll update the offer template. Also: does completion count toward first-week onboarding checklist?
Priya (People Ops): Yes — add to onboarding checklist. People Ops will surface an automated reminder on Day 3 for new hires.
Riley (Engineering): Office hours: can we get a late APAC slot? Past rollouts caused timezone conflicts.
Priya (People Ops): Plan: three slots per week during the 2-week window: 8am PT (EMEA-friendly), 12pm UTC (EU overlap), and 10pm SGT (APAC). We'll record and post the short recap and FAQ.
Sofia (Legal): Accommodation note: employees with documented accessibility needs may request alternate formats or an extended window. Use the "accomms" form linked in the announcement.
Noah (People Ops): We'll send an announcement with: 1) short summary, 2) full redline vs. clean copy, 3) ack link, 4) office hours schedule, 5) accomms form. Draft will go to Legal for sign-off by EOD Tue.
Priya (People Ops): Reminder: hr-bot will auto-send 2 reminders: Day 5 and Day 11 to non-completers. Managers get a weekly digest.
hr-bot: SCHEDULE: Announcement queued for 2026-04-15T09:00:00Z. Reminders set for +5d and +11d. Office hours calendar invites ready.
Riley (Engineering): Can managers see a per-team CSV? We export training CSVs to compliance, but want manager-friendly lists.
Noah (People Ops): Yes — managers have a restricted tracker view with filters. CSV export includes: name, email, role, hire_date, completion_ts, ack_version. We'll store final CSV snapshot in s3://compliance/redwood/ack_snapshots/ and keep for 4 years.
Sofia (Legal): Change retention to 4 years for this policy due to regulator guidance in EU. Update documentation.
Marco (Recruiting Ops): A small edge-case: contingent workers with expired contractor agreements. If they don't have active DPA, mark "external" and don't auto-enroll. We'll provide a manual list to Legal for batching.
Priya (People Ops): Noted. We'll include a contractor status column in the tracker.
Riley (Engineering): One more — will this ack affect promo or performance paperwork?
Sofia (Legal): No, it's compliance documentation only. HR cannot use refusal to sign as a performance metric, but persistent refusal will trigger a separate review per policy.
Noah (People Ops): Action items: Priya to finalize announcement copy + appendix by Tue EOD; Sofia to review redline; Marco to update offer template; Priya to schedule office hours and publish calendar; hr-bot to queue reminders and digest.
Priya (People Ops): I'll drop the manager sample email in #people-ops-resources and pin the FAQ.
Marco (Recruiting Ops): Updated offer snippet I'll post here once done.
Sofia (Legal): Quick legal advisory: proposed appendix text for reporting flow: "To report an incident, contact People Ops directly at people-ops@redwood.ai, or use the anonymous hotline: https://rwd.in/anon-report. Reports are triaged within 48 hours." Please don't modify without Legal.
Noah (People Ops): Thanks. We'll use that verbatim.
Priya (People Ops): Final note: if anyone wants to co-host office hours or prep a department-specific FAQ, DM me. We'll track volunteers in the tracker. :sparkles:
